seed_derivation: sha256(canonicalJSON([seed, family, pool, k/draw])) first16 hex → numpy.default_rng
pool_scope: All 229 same-image/condition/reference/version pools with 7302 quality-eligible independent real answers. Ordinary Manual 177 pools is primary. Doorway/Semi/special separate.
entrants: all remaining real workers for each fixed k-1 background
small_pool_sampling: enumerate all subsets when number <= requested count; otherwise sample unique uniform subsets without replacement
pilot_selection: 3 distinct-building ordinary pools per difficulty, keyed hash order, then 2 doorway and 2 Semi; all chosen before outcomes
expansion: Run this frozen design on pilot, then remaining pools if input and runtime checks pass. Outcomes cannot change seeds, categories, parameters or sample counts.

frozen_fusion.correspondence: mean top/bottom angular distance, cyclic and reverse cuts with skip DP, one person per identity group
frozen_fusion.group_rule: complete linkage of allowed pairwise node matches (NOT whole-answer 9/12 degree clustering)
frozen_fusion.coordinates: all identity members, equal-person medians, periodic medoid anchor
frozen_fusion.connection: most-supported complete projected source ring; ties lexical flagged; no x-sort fallback or human partitions
frozen_fusion.N2: node evidence retained, source-ring sorting deferred
frozen_fusion.source_points: frozen records final points, no extra prepare_record

main.required: both complete, same output node count, comparable bound cyclic ring; tolerances are an engineering diagnostic, not semantic equivalence certification

failure_policy: Every requested team remains in denominator. Preserve separate failures and conditional score means; no zero-filled ability score. A separate bounded delivery utility may assign failure=0 solely for team decision sensitivity.
inference: image and building support; building-equal primary uncertainty. Repeated permutations/variants are not independent people; no newly blind historical holdout claim.
